fusions.name: Spoken Sentence
fusions.desc: A spoken word that deals 8 damage to the target, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Closing Argument
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 22 damage to the first enemy it meets. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Worn Phrasing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
